new_today_news.headline: Unregulated Grease Discharge From San Diego Restaurants Raises Environmental Concern for Waterways and Sewers
new_today_news.summary: Industry experts warn about improper FOG management from commercial kitchens entering wastewater systems. The article emphasizes the importance of clear procedures for used cooking oil, preventing grease from entering drains, and maintaining grease-control equipment.

new_today_news.headline: The Grease Co Highlights Growing Grease Management Concerns as Aging SoCal Sewer Infrastructure Faces More Failures
new_today_news.summary: Southern California restaurant grease management challenges intensify as aging sewer infrastructure deteriorates under FOG pressure. The report highlights proper grease trap cleaning, maintenance, and safe used cooking oil storage as critical mitigation strategies.

new_today_news.headline: Performance and microbial community dynamics in full-scale anaerobic co-digesters fed with fats, oils and grease
new_today_news.summary: Research published October 2026 on full-scale anaerobic digesters shows FOG co-digestion with municipal sludge increases methane yields and improves solids reduction. Study monitored 1.36-million-gallon digesters for 10 months, demonstrating stable operation with measurable benefits.

recent_news.headline: Orange County Restaurants Face Growing Challenges Managing Fats, Oils and Grease (FOG) From Daily Kitchen Activity
recent_news.summary: Orange County grease management experts emphasize proper FOG handling and best practices to prevent wastewater disruptions. Article covers proper used cooking oil separation, grease collection containers, and routine grease trap maintenance requirements.

recent_news.headline: Walnut Creek Wastewater Treatment Plant Expansion
recent_news.summary: Expansion and modernization of Walnut Creek wastewater treatment facility in Austin, Texas, adding 25 million gallons per day of capacity and upgrading treatment processes. Austin Water broke ground in April 2026; project is currently in construction phase.

recent_news.headline: DOT authorizes use of ASME standard for hazardous materials transport tanks
recent_news.summary: Final DOT rule published September 28, 2026, modernizes requirements for cargo tank motor vehicles, cryogenic portable tanks and ton tanks. Updates provide regulatory flexibility and cost savings without compromising safety; voluntary compliance began Sept. 28 with enforcement starting Oct. 28.

recent_news.headline: Meridian Waste Acquires Select Assets of Lafferty Disposal
recent_news.summary: Meridian Waste, an integrated non-hazardous solid waste services company, announced the acquisition of select assets of Lafferty Disposal, a residential waste collection company based in Meherrin, Virginia. The transaction closed on October 1, 2026.

recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients' Waste-to-Fuel Model Underscores Renewable Fuels Leadership
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients operates in the collection and conversion of animal by-products, food waste and used cooking oil into sustainable ingredients and renewable fuels. The company participates in renewable diesel production through Diamond Green Diesel joint venture.

backfill_news.headline: Industry Remains Active on Acquisition Front
backfill_news.summary: Industry overview noting continued M&A activity in the environmental services sector, including GFL Environmental's September 1 acquisition of Secure Waste Infrastructure Corp. for approximately $4.64 billion enterprise value.

backfill_news.headline: GFL Environmental Sets Date for Q3 2026 Results and Investor Call
backfill_news.summary: GFL Environmental announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results will be released after market close on October 28, 2026, with an investor conference call scheduled for October 29, 2026 at 8:30 am ET. The company is a leading North American diversified environmental services provider specializing in solid waste management.
